title: TOPTA: A Shrimp's Tale
description: A modpack designed for small servers hoping to create a beautiful world focussed on myths and fantasy. As well as a jumping off point for those who want to customise a pack to their preferences!
body:
This modpack is a hodgepodge of ideas from a group of friends who enjoy creating modpacks. Up until recently, this has all been done for private fun. This pack changes that. 

Introducing: TOPTA!!!

Or specifically TOPTA: A Shrimp's Tale. Named as such after the main brains behind this specific pack. The intent of the pack is simple, it will allow any who download it to get the basics of a Medieval Fantasy RPG Pack which they can then either play straight, which is what we have been doing, or, add mods which change world gen, perhaps add new dimensions.

It is meant to be a wide encompassing modpack aimed at all levels for Modding experience.

We the Team at TOPTA, hope you enjoy :)
